description: Top 5 and bottom 5 politicians (Congress + executive-branch officials) by estimated trading P&L over a trailing window (default and only supported window: 90 days), plus SPY's return over the same window as a benchmark, and imageUrl: a 2160x2700 PNG card of the same ranking (null when unavailable; card.reason says why). All P&L figures are estimates (estimate: true, estimateRange "±25–40%"): disclosed amount ranges are converted to shares at the historical close, FIFO-matched, and open positions marked to the latest quote. The card prints "Estimates from disclosed amount ranges (±25–40%). Not investment advice." The `metric` field defines the figure: P&L on trades disclosed inside the window only, i.e. realized on round trips opened and closed in the window plus unrealized on positions opened in the window. It is not lifetime P&L; sales of positions bought before the window are not counted. Eligibility: at least 5 trades in the window (eligibility.minTradesInWindow), so a single lucky trade cannot top the board. Each row: slug, fullTitle ("Senator", "Representative", or an executive official's filed title), fullName, displayName, party and state as full words (the publishable form, rather than "Sen." or "D-CA"), estimatedPnl, winRate (0-1; null = no position closed in the window, which is not measured and not 0%), tradesInWindow, unrealizedMeasured, and portraitUrl (always null for executive officials). benchmark.available false means SPY was not measured (benchmark.reason); it is not a 0% return. available false with reason "pending" means the window has not been computed yet, not that nobody traded.

window.description: Trailing window in days. Only 90 is supported (default 90).
